title: Link environment frames
description: Environment stores bindings in linked runtime frames for definition, lookup, assignment, and scope creation.

steps.description: Environment starts with a binding dictionary and an optional parent frame.
define creates a binding in the current frame.
lookup checks this frame first, then walks to its parent, and raises for an undefined name.
assign updates an existing binding in this frame or a parent frame, and raises when no binding exists.
child creates a frame whose parent is this environment. __repr__ collects visible frame key lists.
